_why: loadPairs() read every pair into one array, so a rule tuned against the corpus was scored against the same corpus and overfitting was excluded by nothing. The split is declared here rather than derived from a hash so it is reviewable, stable across runs, and moving a pair between halves is a visible diff.
_rule: Tune is where a pattern may be looked at while it is being written. Holdout is scored and never read during authoring. Both halves carry both languages; a language present on only one side would make its figures uncomparable.
_epoch: Moving any pair between halves starts a new epoch. A holdout figure quoted across a split change is not a comparison.
